caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device with a crank handle and several rows of metal spikes or pins. The main body is rectangular and constructed from brown wood with visible grain texture. There are metal fasteners at the corners holding the wooden parts together. Inside the main frame, there is a rotating drum or cylinder with multiple closely set parallel metal spikes or nails arranged in a row, and another cylindrical spindle running parallel below. The crank handle, also made of wood, extends outward from the right side of the device, with two wooden knobs visible on the frame adjacent to the crank mechanism. The device sits inside a rectangular outline drawn on light beige paper. In the upper left corner, a smaller inset diagram shows a simplified line drawing of the device, including some dimension notations: "4", "9", "11", "20" positioned around the sketch. The primary color palette of the drawing includes various shades of brown for the wood, grey-silver for the metal spikes, and faint red lines for the border and dimension annotations. The illustration is rendered with detailed shading and highlights to emphasize the three-dimensional form and texture of the materials.
title: Sausage Grinder
